svg.aria-label: Frozen checkpoint: two methods, two outcomes, one targeted ablation
svg.text: Frozen checkpoint: two methods, two outcomes, one targeted ablation
Target: 120 decision checkpoints, 30 per station; preserve recording and participant provenance.

g.text: 1 · Freeze the shared input and independent reference
Station / knowledge / model versions · delivered history through the cutoff · source spans and event order
Faculty reference: applicable role requirements and current assessment decision at that same cutoff
Keep the reference out of both model inputs. Future answers or corrections are not visible.
2A · First next-role reply
A conventional + RAG and B DualGraph-OSCE
Both start from the same frozen prefix and state.
Save the first-run finalized reply and failures.
Blind method labels for faculty review.
2B · Current assessment decision
Use the same prefix and cutoff in both methods.
Check state and all applicable consequences,
correction history and review-reason sets.
Final omissions require a closed deadline.
3A · Role compliance = 0 or 1
Valid reply + every applicable requirement passes.
Five categories explain the observed failures.
Do not select a better second attempt.
3B · Assessment exact match = 0 or 1
State and every applicable field equal the reference.
An omitted required cap makes the decision incorrect.
Cache B evidence and rules with their versions.
4 · Paired primary comparison
Same checkpoint, A versus B; two separate endpoints.
Report all eligible checkpoints and failures.
Estimate differences and source-cluster uncertainty.
Repeats and derived variants do not create new students.
5 · Cached-graph ablation
Replay FULL and verify the original rule decision.
Replay UNLINKED: block only role intervention
→ linked assessment consequence. No re-extraction.
Keep negative controls and non-target checks.
6 · Natural-use evidence is reported separately
Students consult freely from the station brief; they do not perform a benchmark script or ablation.
Planned source: 16 live consultation recordings. Verify eligibility, completeness and consent.
Experience feedback describes usability; it does not replace faculty accuracy or role judgments.

svg.text: Protocol diagram, not a result. The technical target is not 120 independent consultations.
